content.title: American Airlines Flight Cancellations Persist as Rivals Move Past Winter Storm
content.summary: Airlines have largely recovered from winter storm Fern’s snow and ice, but American Airlines continues to struggle.  As of midafternoon, more than 950 American flights scheduled for Tuesday have been scrapped.  Regional carrier PSA Airlines, which operates American-branded flights, has shed over a quarter of its schedule.

content.title: What travelers can expect as Southwest Airlines introduces assigned seats
content.summary: Starting Tuesday, customers on Southwest flights will have assigned seats and the option of paying more to get their preferred seat closer to the front of a plane or seats with extra legroom.  Under the open-seat system, Southwest customers could check in starting exactly 24 hours before departure to secure places in boarding lines at departure gates.  Others landed in “B” or “C,” the likelihood of only middle seats being available rising the longer they waited to check in.

content.title: Did Southwest’s Shift to Assigned Seating and Premium Cabins Just Recast Its (LUV) Investment Narrative?
content.summary: Southwest Airlines has begun a major overhaul of its business model, rolling out assigned seating, premium cabins, network expansion, and leadership changes ahead of its fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 results webcast scheduled for January 29, 2026. This shift away from the carrier’s long-standing open-seating approach marks a significant repositioning aimed at competing more directly with full-service airlines while maintaining core brand elements like two free checked bags.
